## Floatick v0.7.0

### 中文

- 扩展设置新增网页 URL 扩展，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 地址，未填写协议时会自动补全 `https://`。
- 网页扩展可直接在 Floatick 内打开，并与原有本地 HTML 扩展统一管理、重命名和删除。
- 扩展菜单新增独立的“浏览器打开”按钮，可用系统默认浏览器打开网页 URL 或本地 HTML 入口文件。
- 使用网页和本地页面专属图标与来源标签，优化扩展设置和下拉菜单的辨识度与交互。
- 保持现有本地扩展数据完全兼容，并加强 URL 协议和入口路径校验。

### English

- Added web URL extensions with HTTP/HTTPS validation and automatic `https://` completion when no scheme is provided.
- Web extensions open directly inside Floatick and share the same management, rename, and removal workflow as local HTML extensions.
- Added a dedicated "Open in browser" action for every extension, supporting both web URLs and local HTML entry files.
- Added distinct web and local-page icons and source badges throughout extension settings and the extension menu.
- Preserved full compatibility with existing local extensions while hardening URL scheme and local entry-path validation.
